name: Camping Lindlbauer
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

Camping Lindlbauer is located in the municipality of Inzell in the Austrian state of Tirol. The campsite is open year-round and provides pitches for RVs and tents. The area is characterized by the mountain landscape of the Chiemgau Alps. In winter, nearby ski resorts like the Winklmoosalm are accessible. In summer, numerous hiking trails invite visitors to explore the natural surroundings. The facilities include sanitary amenities, a grocery store, and a playground. Guests can enjoy a peaceful atmosphere, and the campsite serves as a great starting point for activities in the region.
